item.title: Snippets 1.1
item.description:
Snippets 1.1

  • In-app updates. Snippets can now tell you when a new version is out and install it for you. The second time you open the app, it asks whether to check automatically.
  • Check for Updates… in the Snippets menu, and a new Updates section in Settings ▸ General with an on/off switch and Check Now.

Each update check downloads a list of versions from this site. The privacy policy describes exactly what that request shares.
